entries.title: Intellihub
entries.content:
Intellihub

Automation Engineer | Intellihub Group

08/2025 – 09/2026 • Sydney, Australia (Hybrid)

Intellihub is a major Australian energy technology company providing smart-metering and related energy solutions across Australia and New Zealand. In 2024 it supported 40+ electricity retailers; by 2026 it had become the #1 smart-meter provider in ANZ, delivering 99.5% of meter data reliably.

Test automation role across two platforms: IWS (Intellihub Web Services), a Python-based platform used by operations for service order management, reporting and user access; and SmartCore, a new TypeScript system on Microsoft Azure and D365, designed to replace IWS. Design and maintain BDD test scenarios, enhance the automation frameworks, and review PRs with feedback on code quality and test coverage. Contribute across three frameworks in total, including the Java-based IMDM. Report to the Test Automation Lead, work alongside two offshore automation engineers.


How the frameworks fit together.

Highlights

First BDD scenarios in the daily CI pipeline
-----
Before this, scenarios ran only on demand; now they run daily, giving the team constant feedback.

Automated monitoring for production and test environments
-----
Jenkins pipelines, Python scripts, scheduled checks, email alerts and build badges.

Failure-cause analysis tool
-----
Analyses daily automation execution results, identifies likely failure causes and suggests solutions, with a human review step before anything is acted on.

Lead AI enablement across the team
-----
Monthly knowledge-sharing sessions on practical AI-assisted development (other team members now present their own techniques); .github/copilot-instructions.md (Agents.md) files giving AI agents a repo map at session start; 5 shared GitHub Copilot Skills used by colleagues in daily work; an AI-powered PR review agent saving an estimated 5 to 10% time per review.

entries.title: Figtree Systems
entries.content:
Figtree Systems

QA Product Tester | Test Automation | Figtree Systems

11/2023 – 07/2025 • Sydney, Australia

Figtree Systems is a global provider of business management software specialising in insurance, claims, risk, safety and fleet management. With 40+ years in the market, it supports 150+ organisations globally across four countries, delivering cloud-based SaaS solutions to insurers, government and enterprise customers.

Versatile role covering test automation, QA and manual testing activities (40/20/40 split). Gained broader experience with software development tools, including Atlassian Jira, Confluence and GitLab. Played a key role in regression testing: planning, executing, and reporting test outcomes and defects. Contributed to strengthening the team’s quality practices by promoting root cause analysis (RCA), rewriting acceptance criteria, and leading workshops on exploratory testing, test coverage and effective bug reporting. Helped establish a unit testing framework using Vitest and TypeScript, leveraging experience with AI tools and access to GitHub Copilot. Actively supported team upskilling through practical examples, coaching and toolkits.

Highlights

UI automation, built from scratch
-----
Implemented a UI test automation framework and deployed a Playwright suite covering 50+ scenarios, leading the work and contributing as an automation engineer, saving 4 to 6 hours of manual work per regression run.

QA maturity
-----
Improved QA process maturity by leading workshops and creating exploratory testing and RCA guides, metrics, and standardised defect reporting across the team.

AI initiative
-----
Secured leadership approval for privacy-aware AI open-source solutions tailored to internal use, by delivering a proposal and accompanying documentation covering research, evaluation, recommendations, risks and mitigations.

entries.title: WithYouWithMe
entries.content:
WithYouWithMe

Quality Assurance Test Analyst | WithYouWithMe

11/2021 – 04/2023 • Sydney, Australia

WithYouWithMe builds new talent from overlooked communities, solving digital skills shortages.

Mid-level test analyst role covering a wide range of testing activities: test planning, test case management (Azure Test Plans), defect management, working closely with the development team and stakeholders, analysing requirements. Collaborated with engineers from various teams, including DevOps and Data Analytics. As a member of the QA team, ensured the quality of a web application with B2C and B2B users across 3 production instances in Australia, North America and the UK. Expanded web UI testing skills and gained experience working with API and database layers, testing Azure Functions. Contributed to challenging projects such as localisation testing, migration of data from AWS to Azure storage, and testing an LMS (WordPress) with 50+ courses.

Highlights
-----
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) certification. Played one of the key roles in establishing the team’s test management system in Azure DevOps: developed from scratch and maintained a comprehensive regression test suite for manual testing with 300+ tests. Introduced the Common Vulnerability Scoring System into team practices to improve security issue prioritisation. Acknowledged as a vital contributor to QA team documentation and financially awarded by the company.

Software QA Engineer | WithYouWithMe

04/2023 – 07/2023 • Sydney, Australia

Primary focus on manual testing: functional, security, accessibility, usability and exploratory testing of a web application. Recognised as a dedicated tester with a strong desire to learn, consistently providing clear and detailed defect reports. Expanded experience in test automation with TestComplete and Postman: defining testing scope, prioritising, designing automated tests, setting up a TestComplete project, submitting automation PRs with Git and Azure DevOps, integrating tests into Azure CI/CD, creating documentation, reporting progress.

Highlights
-----
One of the key roles in the team’s transition to test automation: contributed to setting up and creating from scratch an automated test suite (TestComplete) for production validation testing. Introduced Postman monitors for faster feedback across multiple production and test environments via scheduled API test execution. Created a Postman collection with REST API and GraphQL requests that sped up test data preparation.

entries.title: Aerofiler
entries.content:
Aerofiler

Software Tester (part-time) | Aerofiler Pty Ltd

08/2019 – 09/2021 • Sydney, Australia

Aerofiler is a Sydney-based startup building smart cloud-based document management solutions to help organisations easily and effectively file, search, review and analyse documents.

- Performed exploratory, end-to-end, regression, acceptance and ad hoc testing.
- Tested integrations with Salesforce, AdobeSign, DocuSign, Zapier, Dropbox and Namirial.
- Developed test scenarios and testing checklists from specifications, feature updates and documentation.
- Collaborated with development and testing teams on reported issues, feedback, work status and testing scope.
- Filed and tracked bug reports in GitHub issues with concise, clear write-ups.

Highlights
-----
Team recognition for exceptional exploratory testing. Progressed from testing intern to a part-time contractor position, financially awarded several times. Created a repository of 800+ test items in a test case management tool to improve regression testing. Wrote 40 web UI tests using Selenium WebDriver and Python. Used markdown, Git, GitHub, Python and JavaScript basics to build a system for documenting, reporting and tracking testing activities.
